selection: One known photo instruction template; both P64 ordinary interfaces, each once from a fresh task. Posthoc development control selected after P65. Not independent confirmation.
scope: Hand-authored public receipt monitor using unchanged P62/P65 move checks. Extra conservative guard rejects unhandled non-file app effects and nonchronological events. No future record or evaluator response is supplied during execution.
comparison: Compare with the closed corresponding P64 baseline, including whole logical input/output, APIs and time. Do not assume a deterministic shared prefix: audit requests, messages, events and final non-supervisor database hashes. Historical paired runs, not randomized repeated causal estimates.
failure_policy: No retry or replacement. Known task/model budget closure is evaluated then next fixed condition. Unknown effects, setup/runtime/cleanup/evaluation failure, controller completion failure, source/server drift, explicit stop or process limit stops remaining schedule.
allocation_rule: Exactly two conditions, at most 160 model calls, 900000 logical tokens, 320 environment APIs including controller completion, two evaluations. All measured and unknown costs retained.
